title: Friday runtime roundup — agenda + follow-ups (scratchpad)
body:
Purpose: quick sync to land urgent follow-ups from the week, surface regressions, and confirm next-week focus for serving-runtime / infra / console cross work. Tone: time-boxed, pragmatic.

Meeting length: 30 minutes (standup style). Attendees: eng-serving-runtime core + console liaison + one infra SRE.

Pre-read (send 24h before): p95 latency trend screenshot (last 7 days), recent canary deploy notes, small failure-rate table from observability.

Agenda (30m):
1) 0-3m: Quick wins + kudos (who shipped, feature toggles changed) — (me).
2) 3-10m: Latency/Errors snapshot (Priya) — focus on two anomalies: KV cache miss-rate spike Wed 10:30 and a new p95 tail on long-context batches.
3) 10-17m: Rollouts & model variants (Arjun) — where are we on the v2 routing fallback and staging rollouts for quantized-ev1? Any manual rollbacks?
4) 17-23m: Console & Ops needs (Ellie) — checklist for per-route token-level cost drilldown, required tracing hooks for next canary.
5) 23-28m: Action items review + owners (all).
6) 28-30m: Parking lot + blockers (rapid callouts).

Notes / talking points (scratch):
- KV cache miss spike: correlates with a burst of long-context requests from partner test harness at 10:20-10:45. Suspect cache key encoding bug during compression change.
- p95 tail on long-context batches: repro locally when batch size > 12 with quantized kernels on A100s. Could be scheduling thrash with async prefetch.
- Canary: v2 routing enabled for 10% traffic in us-west. No automatic fallback triggered but observed 0.3% increase in 5xxs in one pod pool. Need to check that the fallback policy is wired to the newer model-compat check.
- Console: Cost drilldown is missing per-route grouping for multi-tenant customers; UI can show aggregate but not breakdown by model-variant. Ops need this to justify cost-savings on cache tuning.
- Observability: Add a lightweight synthetic that exercises long-context path every 5m (low QPS) to catch p95 regressions earlier.

Parking lot:
- Longer discussion about kernel scheduling redesign — move to next architecture sync.
- Explore automatic quantization-level fallback for requests that exceed a latency threshold.

Quick decisions needed before Monday:
- Temp mitigation for KV cache miss: revert compression PR to toggle-off mode? (decision: toggle-off; owner: me).
- Synthetic probe added? (decision: yes; owner: Priya).

Meeting prep checklist (for me):
- Attach p95 graph and canary logs to calendar invite.
- Add concrete failure examples (trace ids) for Priya.
- Confirm Ellie can demo console filter for a single tenant.

Tone notes to self: keep it tight, call out only 2-3 critical action items to avoid scatter. Use the 5-min post-meeting follow-up email with owners & due dates.
